build_vaat_model: build a Vision-Audio-Action Transformer model combining ViT and AST encoders for robot policy learning
create_vit_vision_encoder: create a Vision Transformer encoder for image patch embedding with cls token and register tokens
create_ast_audio_encoder: create an Audio Spectrogram Transformer encoder that converts raw audio or spectrogram to tokens
test_vaat_forward_pass: test the VAAT forward pass with video images, audio, task conditioning, and advantage tokens
run_vaat_training_loop: run VAAT training with L1 loss on predicted action chunks given visual and audio inputs
